I found two ticket numbers for Quarrendon Freight Lines in Moss's notes:

1. **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025. Drivers at the Eau Claire yard weren't getting text messages with their bay assignments when they checked in at the gatehouse. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed on 5 Oct that it was fixed.
2. **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners couldn't read trailer tags at Door 14 on the third shift. It went to tier-2 support for scanner firmware testing. The note has no date and no resolution.

Things to watch for the deck:
- Moss's Central handoffs note (2 Jan 2026) also lists tickets #4409, #4412 and FR-882. Those belong to Marrow Fieldworks and Marrow Agrisupply, not Quarrendon.
- Marcus's note "Competitive intel: Quarendon Freightways" is about a different company with a similar name. It isn't a customer.
- Moss's other Quarrendon notes (the 14 Sep 2025 pipeline digest and the 23 Mar 2026 renewal note) mention the account but have no ticket numbers.

I only checked Moss's notes in the shared files, not the support system, so there may be other Quarrendon tickets that aren't listed here.
